label: late original-phase steps in sequences starting h/u/j (sparse history conjunction)
explanation: Fires only in the original phase at steps t=3..8 (mostly 4-7, last few tokens before <DEL>), never at the delimiter or during copy. Strongly enriched when the first token is h or u (~11x), then j/d, and when early tokens include d/u/x/v; current-token enrichment for w/q/b. The necessary context (first token h/u/j, t>=4) covers ~83% of activations but with <1% precision; adding orig(1) in {d,u} gives F1 ~0.12 on dev. Activation looks like a sparse conjunction over the stored prefix that no simple predicate captures. Magnitude is low (mean 0.13) and roughly flat across these conditions; top activations fall in sequences beginning u d d / h u d.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=h (+5.67), orig0=u (+5.36), orig1=d (+4.47), orig0=j (+4.28), orig1=u (+3.82), orig1=v (+3.26). Lower it: orig_idx=-1 (-6.52), prev3_tok=- (-4.84), in_tok=s (-2.75), in_tok=i (-2.60).
